title: SG-3 · Create coherent temporary pixel-art bedroom assets
summary: Layered temporary pixel-art bedroom assets registered in the manifest, documented as non-production and covered by unit tests
description: Context: game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room holds one flattened bedroom background, three furniture SVGs, three object SVGs, one idle-only boy sheet and one dust SVG. Desired behavior: separate layered files for background, furniture, objects, characters and effects are registered in manifest.json with dimensions, frames and animations, and a document lists replacement requirements. Expected result: manifest-driven, validated, no gray placeholders. Why: future cycles can swap individual assets.
acceptance_criteria: Given the manifest, when loaded, then wall, floor, window and lighting background assets, five furniture assets, computer, books, door, window and secret door state assets, three boy sheets and dust and glow effects all exist as separate files
Given a spritesheet entry, when validated, then frameCount matches the sheet dimensions and every animation frame index is valid
Given the replacement document, when read, then it lists temporary-asset replacement requirements and does not claim production quality
Given every manifest entry, when resolved, then it points to an existing file

in_scope: schema validation of frames and animations
preserve: existing manifest ids such as scene:bedroom, objects/bed and character:boy

technical_constraints: Use crisp pixel-art SVG (shape-rendering=crispEdges) with explicit integer width/height
Manifest typed by zod schema in game/src/assets/manifest/schema.ts
definition_of_done: All requirements delivered and unit tests green
